content.rendered: “Came behind him, and touched the border of his garment: and immediately her issue of blood stanched.” (Luke 8: 44)That is the Focal Scripture of Streams of Joy Devotional today.Our Focal Scripture speaks of that moment when the woman with the issue of blood touched the hem of Jesus’ garment. In bible times, anyone who touched or was touched by a person with the issue of blood was also deemed unclean (see Leviticus 15 vs. 25-27). So while in that crowd, that woman was about to make whomsoever she touched to become unclean.Notice that the crowd was more concerned about Jesus, and they probably never noticed the woman with the issue of blood until she got healed. That crowd concealed her negative situation, so she had the chance to push until she touched Jesus and got healed. That crowd covered her disadvantage for her until she got her miracle. The law was against her movement towards Jesus, but the crowd made it easier.Friend, there may be laws against your movement and progress, there may be people who have vowed that you will not move forward, there may be policies that have been set up to hinder or completely halt your advancement in destiny, but God is orchestrating a situation that will work in your favour. God will provide a divine cover for you so that you can move despite the rules and people standing against you.God will create a situation that will overshadow whatever was planned against you; God will create a situation and an alignment that will scatter the policies that were put up to stop you from rising higher; God will orchestrate a chain of events that will hinder your disadvantages; God will orchestrate a chain of events that will halt every report that is not in your favour; God will create a scenario that will cover you and help you rise.Get set: every pronouncement or law that is against your rising and advancement, the Lord speaks against it; you can’t be stopped; God will cover you.Psalm 18: 35 says: “Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy right hand hath holden me up, and thy gentleness hath made me great.”Declare With Me: God will create situations to cover my disadvantages; what is written against me is nullified, in Jesus’ name!Follow on Instagram @jerry_ezeFollow on Twitter @jerrystreams
